reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthWideCategories selection that all six month-wide actions already use, rather than touching each action's filtering.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is decided once in getMonthWideCategories; actions share a MonthWideActionArgs type and only forward the flag (the repeated `!!includeHiddenCategories` coercion is trivial).

placement.why: The variation lives in the shared category-selection function in budget/actions.ts, where the other month-wide exclusions are decided.

scope.why: Only the selection function, the action signatures and tests.

maintainability.why: One parameter on one selection function; the comment states which exclusions are optional and which always apply.
